citation.title: Acute effects of exercise intensity on butyrylcholinesterase and ghrelin in young men: A randomized controlled study
citation.journal: Journal of Exercise Science and Fitness

population.description: Fifteen healthy young Japanese men (Table 1: age 22.7 +/- 1.8 y, BMI 22.2 +/- 2.6 kg/m2, VO2max 56.3 +/- 4.2 mL/kg/min, mean +/- SD). Exclusion criteria included age <20 or >30 y, medication or supplements, major illness, smoking; these are enrolment limits, so min and max are left null. Ghrelin and BChE were analysed in 12 of them; glucose, insulin, heart rate and RER in all 15. VO2max (Table 1, mean +/- SD): 'Maximum oxygen uptake (mL/kg/min) 56.3 +/- 4.2'.

protocols.name: run_low
protocols.description: Plasma glucose and insulin: venous samples at 09:30, 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30 and 12:00. Arrival 08:45 after a 10-h overnight fast (water only; 200 mL on waking and 50 mL on arrival, then water ad libitum), arm starts at arrival (08:45 = minute 0), so the sample at 09:30 is minute 45 and 12:00 is minute 195. No food during the trial. 60-min treadmill run 09:30-10:30 (minutes 45 to 105) at a speed eliciting 40% of VO2max. Level derived, not printed: from the oxygen uptake measured during the bout, Table 2, 21.5 mL/kg/min (38.4% of VO2max); level = (21.5 - 3.7)/31.7 = 0.562. Convention: the activity segment runs from minute 45 to 106 (the bout is 60 min, 09:30-10:30) so that the 10:30 sample at minute 105 falls with the input on.

protocols.name: run_high
protocols.description: Plasma glucose and insulin: venous samples at 09:30, 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30 and 12:00. Arrival 08:45 after a 10-h overnight fast (water only; 200 mL on waking and 50 mL on arrival, then water ad libitum), arm starts at arrival (08:45 = minute 0), so the sample at 09:30 is minute 45 and 12:00 is minute 195. No food during the trial. 60-min treadmill run 09:30-10:30 (minutes 45 to 105) at a speed eliciting 70% of VO2max. Level derived, not printed: from the oxygen uptake measured during the bout, Table 2, 36.2 mL/kg/min (65.1% of VO2max); level = (36.2 - 3.7)/31.7 = 1.025; level above 1.0: the model extrapolates here. Convention: the activity segment runs from minute 45 to 106 (the bout is 60 min, 09:30-10:30) so that the 10:30 sample at minute 105 falls with the input on.

protocols.name: rest_control
protocols.description: Plasma glucose and insulin: venous samples at 09:30, 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30 and 12:00. Arrival 08:45 after a 10-h overnight fast (water only; 200 mL on waking and 50 mL on arrival, then water ad libitum), arm starts at arrival (08:45 = minute 0), so the sample at 09:30 is minute 45 and 12:00 is minute 195. No food during the trial. Control trial: seated on a chair, 09:30 to 12:00, no exercise.
